author: 783jjdhufy

title: Bardzo fajna aplikacja ale nie za tą cenę
body: Dobra aplikacja, działa prawidłowo, fajna od strony graficznej, przemyślana ale ta cena nie ma żadnego uzasadnienia. Ktoś jest zachłanny i chcę po prostu jak najwięcej zarobić dając coś co jest dobre albo nawet bardzo dobre ale mimo wszystko nie warte takiej kwoty.
author: ZaylPOL

title: Great app but the pricing is too much
body: I basically only use the app to log habits but I just found out through a popup screen that after the trial ends you’re only left with one habit only which basically makes the app useless. It’s another great app which I won’t use because of subscription model
author: Wiencon

title: Not everything has to have an expensive subscription
body:
120$ a year - that’s the subscription price for the PRO version which is well hidden until you actually create an account.

It’s to expensive for what you are getting. 

The rest is actually nice, but right now everything switches to subscription model, and that would’ve been fine if not for such a steep price. 

Good luck.
author: Prince Lestat

title: Unjustified pricing
body:
I installed the app and besides it’s beautiful it doesn’t offer anything of value for the price. It’s super expensive monthly for an app that let’s you click w button to keep track of a habit you’re forming. 

Atomic Habit quotes - it’s way better money spent if you buy the book. 

I’d love to revisit the app if it has a reasonable pricing plan.

title: Looks awesome, just the price
body: The app looks awesome and has a lot of great content from James. I will not pay for pro account though because it is too expensive compering to other apps with similar/more features - its almost as expensive as superhuman
author: sy.rob

title: The app is absolutely magnificent, however the subscription is rather on the expensive side.
body:
I love pretty much everything about the app; how it guides you through creating your habits, gently reminds you to cast a vote for the version of yourself you set out to achieve, the animations are very well crafted and the app is just a pleasure to use.

My only gripe - the subscription price. To me it seems like it hasn’t been adjusted to different countries’ purchasing powers. As it currently stands it’s rather expensive in my region, so much so that buying the Atomic Habits book seems like a much better deal. But perhaps I haven’t dug in deep enough to see past the content already included in the book. Should I do so, I’ll try to edit this review.

Thanks James Clear!
author: bartoszek
